commands.checks: Standard library, about 0.03 s and 19 MB. Recomputes the figures of README section 5 with every hidden constant set to 1: the factor ln ln n / sqrt(ln n) at n = 10^4, 10^6 and 10^30 (0.73, 0.71, 0.51); the n beyond which the sharper exponent beats 1.307^n (10^78.7, printed as 10^79); the n beyond which the Lean exponent beats 2^n (10^2390.2, printed as 10^2390). Checks that README.md prints each figure as computed, and that four false figures are rejected (0.80 at 10^4, 0.61 at 10^30, 10^50 and 10^239). Prints PASS_ETH_CLAIM_FFT_IMPACT.
